args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08.
All three final checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) passed on every run. No run used the width-free ratio and no run had a roll back.
The REGR peak is at 421 µm and the largest flank difference is at 410 µm in every run.
The large |z| values only reflect very small batch MADs. r08's REGR peak (52.92 %/h, z 3.37) is 0.24 % above the median. The 674 µm growth zones of r01, r07 and r08 (z -3.51) are about 4 % shorter than the 700 µm median. That is a small spread in the velocity profile, not a different shape.
r01 and r07 each kept one remedy, and all checks pass on the result. r08 took 5 steps but kept no remedy and ended at stride 1, so its rates were not changed.
Nothing is flagged, so there is no shared fault.
Note for follow-up: r02, r03, r04 and r06 have exactly the same check values and summaries, and so do r01 and r07. It may be worth confirming that these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicated inputs.
